verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own bulk capabilities: paying vendors, employees and contractors in bulk across 150+ countries, and 'batch payments' alongside the Instant Pay SDKs. The MCP server can also export filtered transactions to CSV, an agent-accessible operation that spans many records. However, these are thin marketing-level claims, and bulk support is shown only for payments. Card and expense actions in the MCP and API appear to be per-item. missing for 10: documented batch API endpoint or schema for bulk payments, bulk operations exposed via MCP for agents, bulk card or expense management actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
